Needed when a direct connection cannot be established (strict NAT). Without it a free public server is used. Applies from the next call.
Nostr servers that deliver the call request. One per line. You and the other person must share at least one.
The app never sends anything by itself. The error log stays on the device; you can share it manually if something goes wrong.
This is your own invitation — send it to the other person
This is an answer, not an invitation. Answers are pasted on the outgoing call screen
“%1$s” will be removed from the list. The code can be added again.
No connection to relays. Check your internet and VPN
The app stays connected while closed. A silent notification is shown — you can hide it in Android settings
Calls from codes that are not in your contacts are dropped
Android may put the app to sleep and delay calls. To prevent that, allow it to run without battery restrictions.
Voice calls directly between phones: no sign-up, no phone number, no servers.
Send your code to the other person with the buttons at the top of the main screen (copy, share or QR) and get theirs.
The “Contact” button: paste the code or scan the QR. A call from someone not in your contacts shows as “Unknown caller”.
Tap the handset next to a contact — the other phone rings even if the app is closed.
Allow the microphone and notifications. The banner at the top is green when you can be called; if it is not, tap it — it says what to fix.
If the other person is offline, the invitation can be sent manually — the button appears on the call screen.
Add someone by their code to call them
Old code — ask for a new one and add it again
Paste the invitation the other person sent. Faster: tap “Share → DP Call” in the messenger, or just copy it and open the app.
This is an old-format code. Ask the other person to update the app and send a new code
Invalid code: it must be 52 characters long
You cannot add your own code
A contact with this code already exists
This code is not signed or was altered. Ask the sender to update the app and send it again
This invitation has expired. Ask for a new one
This answer is not from the person you are calling
The other phone may be offline. You can keep waiting or send the invitation through a messenger.
Notifications are off — you will not see incoming calls
Reachable only while the app is open
Online, but Android may put the app to sleep
If the other person is offline, an encrypted note about your call waits for them on the relays for 48 hours. You get such notes too
Once a day the app asks GitHub for the latest version. Installed: %1$s
For when a call could not get through and the invitation was sent through a messenger. Usually it is picked up automatically — from “Share → DP Call” or the clipboard.
Your code lives only on this phone. A backup file keeps the code and contacts, so you can move them to another phone or restore them after reinstalling.
This is not a DP Call backup file
The file is encrypted with your password. Without the password it cannot be restored — and anyone who has both the file and the password can receive your calls.
The code on this phone will be replaced by the code from the backup; its contacts will be added to yours. Do not use one code on two phones at once.

Have the other person point their phone camera at the code — the DP Call download opens. Or send them the link.
The network blocks calls: no direct path and no TURN
TURN unavailable — on some networks a call may not connect
Calls should connect on this network.
Calls connect when at least one side has a direct path. If the other person is behind a strict network or VPN, set your own TURN server in Settings → Advanced.
Sound cannot get through this network. Try another network, turn the VPN off or set your own TURN server in Settings → Advanced.
No relay is reachable: calls will not reach you. Check the internet connection and VPN.
Call right away or save to contacts.
Scan the other person\'s code instead.
%1$s may close the app — allow autostart
This phone closes background apps on top of Android\'s battery saving. Without these permissions calls arrive late or not at all.
Settings → Apps → DP Call: turn on Autostart; Battery saver → No restrictions. In recent apps, pull DP Call down and lock it.
Settings → Battery → App launch → DP Call: turn off \"Manage automatically\" and turn on all three switches.
Settings → Battery → DP Call: allow background activity and Auto launch. In recent apps, lock DP Call.
Settings → Battery → High background power consumption: turn on for DP Call. i Manager → App manager → Autostart: allow DP Call.
Settings → Battery → Background usage limits → Never sleeping apps: add DP Call. Make sure it is not in Sleeping or Deep sleeping apps.
Security → Permissions → Background management: allow DP Call to run in the background.
Mobile Manager → PowerMaster → Auto-start manager: allow DP Call.
If calls still do not get through, turn on \"Always connected\" in Settings.
For phones that close the app anyway. Keeps the connection alive in deep sleep; uses noticeably more battery.

The phone will not fully sleep: the app keeps the processor awake and checks the connection every 25 seconds. Expect several percent more battery use per day. Turn it on only if calls do not get through with the other settings.
Calls should connect through the public TURN, but your own server does not respond: check its address, login and password in Settings → Advanced.
